findings.summary: Product thumbnails add repeated or extraneous names to category-button, cart-row, and inventory-row announcements.
findings.fix: Allow context-specific alt text and use alt="" for these thumbnails when the visible category or adjacent product name already identifies the control or item.
findings.evidence: ProductImage always sets alt={product.name}; these uses also render the category label or adjacent product name.

passed: Catalog and search cards use a semantic img with product-name alt text; their detail buttons have explicit action labels.
Detail images and management previews retain image alternatives, including a named fallback when an image fails to load.
File and URL previews use the current product name as alt text; responsive object-fit sizing preserves the full image without replacing it with a CSS background.
notes: Custom uploaded or URL images vary at runtime, so their content-to-name match cannot be verified from source alone.
